title_en: Fall 2026 Graduate Thesis Submission Deadline Extension Applications Due 24 July
summary: Graduate students whose thesis submission deadline has passed (master's students 4 to under 6 years after completing coursework; doctoral students 6 to under 8 years after completing coursework) who wish to extend that deadline must apply. They must submit one Application for Extension of Thesis Submission Deadline by Friday, 24 July 2026. They may submit it at the department office (Building 301, Room 319) or by email.
applies_to: Graduate students whose thesis submission deadline has passed and who wish to apply for an extension. Master's students: 4 years or more but less than 6 years after completing coursework. Doctoral students: 6 years or more but less than 8 years after completing coursework. This includes students counting periods of military service or pregnancy and childbirth, because these periods are not extended automatically and must be approved through this application.

dates.what: Deadline to submit the Application for Extension of Thesis Submission Deadline (in person or by email)

conditions: Under Article 11(3) of the Degree Conferral Regulations, an extension may be approved for up to 2 years after review by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee.
The maximum possible extension is up to 6 years after coursework completion for master's students and up to 8 years for doctoral students.
Periods of military service and of pregnancy and childbirth do not count toward the thesis submission deadline, but they are not extended automatically; you must apply and receive approval.
An approval email from your advisor may be submitted in place of the advisor's signature; it must be submitted together with the application.
Leave the department head's signature field blank.
Students granted an extension must register as a research student in the semester in which their thesis is reviewed (KRW 200,000 for engineering fields).
The thesis must be submitted within the approved extended deadline.

Students who have passed the maximum possible extension cannot use this application and must instead apply for registration as a 'Research Student Exceeding the Thesis Submission Deadline' (see the related notice linked in the original; it was not read).
steps: Download and read the attached form, 'Application for Extension of Thesis Submission Deadline' (학위논문제출기한 연장신청서 양식, .hwp file). Its content was not read for this translation.

Complete the form. Example for a doctoral student: if the coursework completion date is August 2020, the thesis submission deadline is August 2026, so write 'until August 2028' as the requested extension.
Obtain your advisor's signature on the form, or obtain an approval email from your advisor to submit instead of the signature.
Leave the department head's signature field blank.

By Friday, 24 July 2026, submit the application (with the advisor's approval email, if used) to the department office (Building 301, Room 319) or by email; the email address is in the original notice.
If the extension is approved, register as a research student (KRW 200,000 for engineering fields) in the semester in which your thesis will be reviewed.
Submit your thesis within the approved extended deadline.
translation:
[Graduate School] Fall 2026 Application for Extension of Thesis Submission Deadline (due by 24 July)

1. Who may apply for an extension of the thesis submission deadline
- Master's program: students who completed coursework 4 years or more but less than 6 years ago
- Doctoral program: students who completed coursework 6 years or more but less than 8 years ago
※ Under Article 11(3) of the Degree Conferral Regulations, when a student whose thesis submission deadline has passed applies for an extension, the extension may be approved for up to 2 years after review by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee. (Maximum possible extension: up to 6 years after coursework completion for the master's program, and up to 8 years after coursework completion for the doctoral program.)
※ Periods of military service and of pregnancy and childbirth are not counted toward the thesis submission deadline. However, the deadline is not extended automatically, so you must apply for an extension and receive approval.

2. Documents to submit
- See the attachment: one copy of the Application for Extension of Thesis Submission Deadline

3. Submitting the application
A. How to submit: Submit by Friday, 24 July 2026 (2026. 7. 24.(금)) to the department office (Building 301, Room 319) or by email.
※ An approval email from your advisor may replace the advisor's signature; submit it together with the application. (Leave the department head's signature field blank.)
B. Example of how to fill in the form: doctoral program
If the 'coursework completion date' is 'August 2020' → the thesis submission deadline is August 2026 → write 'until August 2028' as the 'extension requested'.

4. Important notes
A. Students approved for an extension of the thesis submission deadline must register as a research student (KRW 200,000 for engineering fields) in the semester in which their thesis is reviewed.
B. The thesis must be submitted within the approved extended deadline.
C. Students who have passed the maximum possible extension must apply for registration as a 'Research Student Exceeding the Thesis Submission Deadline' (학위논문제출기한 초과자 연구생). → Related notice: link in the original notice (not read).

● Inquiries: Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachment (1): Application for Extension of Thesis Submission Deadline form (학위논문제출기한 연장신청서 양식 (3).hwp, 35 KB). The attachment's content was not read.
